summary_zh.motivation: 预测选区激光熔化TiAl6V4合金的疲劳强度，保障增材制造部件的可靠性。

summary_en.motivation: To predict the fatigue strength of TiAl6V4 alloy fabricated by selective laser melting for structural reliability.
summary_en.method: Fatigue testing combined with analytical modeling was used to develop a strength prediction method.
summary_en.result: Fatigue properties of SLM TiAl6V4 were characterized and a predictive model was established.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through standard fatigue experiments.

papers.title: SLM produced porous titanium implant improvements for enhanced vascularization and osteoblast seeding.
papers.abstract: To improve well-known titanium implants, pores can be used for increasing bone formation and close bone-implant interface. Selective Laser Melting (SLM) enables the production of any geometry and was used for implant production with 250-µm pore size. The used pore size supports vessel ingrowth, as bone formation is strongly dependent on fast vascularization. Additionally, proangiogenic factors promote implant vascularization. To functionalize the titanium with proangiogenic factors, polycaprolactone (PCL) coating can be used. The following proangiogenic factors were examined: vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), high mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) and chemokine (C-X-C motif) ligand 12 (CXCL12). As different surfaces lead to different cell reactions, titanium and PCL coating were compared. The growing into the porous titanium structure of primary osteoblasts was examined by cross sections. Primary osteoblasts seeded on the different surfaces were compared using Live Cell Imaging (LCI). Cross sections showed cells had proliferated, but not migrated after seven days. Although the cell count was lower on titanium PCL implants in LCI, the cell count and cell spreading area development showed promising results for titanium PCL implants. HMGB1 showed the highest migration capacity for stimulating the endothelial cell line. Future perspective would be the incorporation of HMGB1 into PCL polymer for the realization of a slow factor release.

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文关注多孔钛植入体的生物学性能（血管化和成骨细胞接种），未涉及力学性能、应力遮挡或疲劳测试。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no surface roughness or as-built morphology characterization, no osseointegration quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过多孔结构增强钛植入体的血管化和成骨细胞接种。
summary_zh.method: SLM制备250µm孔径多孔钛，PCL包覆促血管生成因子，体外细胞实验。
summary_zh.result: 细胞增殖但未迁移；PCL涂层降低细胞计数但改善铺展；HMGB1促进内皮细胞迁移。
summary_zh.validation: 利用横截面和活细胞成像评估成骨细胞及内皮细胞反应。

summary_en.motivation: To improve titanium implants by promoting vascularization and osteoblast seeding using porous architecture and bioactive coatings.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate porous titanium scaffolds with 250 µm pores, followed by PCL coating loaded with proangiogenic factors (VEGF, HMGB1, CXCL12) and in vitro cell assays.
summary_en.result: Osteoblasts proliferated but did not migrate after seven days; PCL coating reduced initial cell count but improved spreading; HMGB1 exhibited the highest chemotactic effect on endothelial cells.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via cross-sectional histology and live cell imaging on primary osteoblasts and an endothelial cell line.
